modules: Agent 调用协议
Agent command protocol
任务参数 → JSON 响应、退出码、错误、warning、产物与 provenance；能力与 schema 可查询。
Task arguments → JSON responses, exit codes, errors, warnings, artifacts and provenance; queryable capabilities and schema.
version; doctor; capabilities; schema show
Skill 组织任务，CLI 执行；没有后台云端 Agent 服务。
Skills guide the task; the CLI executes it. No hosted Agent service.
可编辑项目
Editable projects
创建/检查 Agent Project，保存资产、序列、轨道、ticks 时钟、输出配置和权利引用。
Create/inspect Agent Projects with assets, sequences, tracks, tick clocks, output settings and rights references.
project init/inspect
源媒体与项目元数据分离，移动工程后需重链并复核证据路径。
Source media and metadata are separate; relocation requires relinking and evidence-path review.
事务、恢复与快照
Transactions, recovery and snapshots
写入前快照、恢复、迁移、锁和操作记录；中断后恢复项目元数据事务。
Pre-write snapshots, restore, migration, locks and operation records; recover interrupted metadata transactions.
project snapshot/restore/migrate/recover; operation inspect
失败证据保留；快照不等于外部原始素材的完整备份。
Failure evidence remains. Metadata snapshots do not back up all external media.
素材导入与重链
Media ingestion and relinking
本地图片/视频/音频/字体 → 探测结果、稳定资产 ID、哈希和来源记录。
Local images/video/audio/fonts → probe results, stable asset IDs, hashes and provenance.
media ingest/relink
不抓取在线素材；导入不自动证明商业授权。
No online-media fetching; ingestion does not establish commercial rights.
代理、缩略图与波形
Proxies, thumbnails and waveforms
素材 → 轻量代理、图片缩略图、音频波形、可核查联系表。
Media → lightweight proxies, thumbnails, waveforms and auditable contact sheets.
media prepare/contact-sheet
联系表是抽样证据；不代表逐帧视觉理解。
Contact sheets are samples, not exhaustive visual understanding.
镜头、静音与高光分析
Scene, silence and highlight analysis
本地视频/音频 → 切镜、静音、节拍或启发式高光候选与时间证据。
Local video/audio → scene, silence, beat or heuristic highlight candidates and timing evidence.
media understand/highlights
高光是启发式候选，语义判断需要 Agent/已注册适配器复核。
Heuristic candidates require Agent or registered-adapter review for semantics.
智能粗剪与广告计划
Rough cuts and ad plans
经检查的静音/文本片段或广告 brief → 编辑计划 → 可编辑粗剪。
Reviewed silence/transcript segments or an ad brief → edit plan → editable rough cut.
media smart-cut; ad plan/apply
计划与实际 apply 分开；不承诺自动导演效果或投放表现。
Planning and applying are separate; no automatic directing or campaign-performance guarantee.
节拍剪辑与多机同步
Beat cuts and multicamera sync
节拍锚点/本地多机音轨 → 剪切或 offset/显式 affine 时钟及切机计划。
Beat anchors/local camera audio → cuts or offset/explicit affine clocks and switch plans.
media beat-cut/multicam
低置信度、覆盖不足、非线性漂移需拒绝/显式处理；不自动添加音轨。
Low confidence, coverage shortfalls and nonlinear drift require refusal or explicit treatment; audio tracks remain explicit.
多轨基础剪辑
Multitrack editing
编辑 JSON → 加轨、插入、更新、拆分、删除、时长/位置修改与画幅设置。
Edit JSON → tracks, insertion, updates, split/delete, duration/placement edits and canvas settings.
timeline compose/edit
遵守轨道锁、整数 ticks、资产时长与实际能力契约。
Track locks, integer ticks, asset duration and advertised contracts apply.
范围与输出窗口编辑
Range and output-window edits
明确区间 → 裁切/删除/波纹等范围编辑，保留作者时间与源映射。
Explicit ranges → trim/delete/ripple edits while preserving author time and source mapping.
timeline edit
复杂变速与嵌套的组合需按具体契约检查，不推断所有组合均可用。
Check contracts for complex retiming/nesting combinations rather than assuming universal support.
源句柄、滑移与滑动
Source handles, slip and slide
源入出点与邻接片段 → 可逆源编辑、源句柄转场和剪口调整。
Source in/out points and neighbors → reversible source edits, handle transitions and cut adjustments.
timeline edit/transition
源句柄不足会报错；不以静默复制帧替代。
Insufficient source handles are reported rather than silently inventing coverage.
磁吸、主轨与关联音画
Magnetic tracks and linked edits
主轨块重排、关联 ID、音画附着 → 结构化编辑并保持相对关系。
Primary-track block reordering, linked IDs and attached audio → structured edits preserving relationships.
timeline edit
锁、边界和关联选择规则会阻止不明确编辑；不是拖拽式 GUI。
Locks, boundaries and link-selection rules constrain ambiguous edits.
复合与嵌套序列
Compound and nested sequences
子序列 → 独立画布合成、父变换/透明度、嵌套时钟与定格。
Child sequences → independent canvases, parent transforms/opacity, nested clocks and freezes.
timeline compose/edit
独立空间不代表独立色彩/帧率；部分组级空间转场未接受。
Independent spatial canvases do not imply independent color/fps; some group spatial transitions remain unsupported.
变速、倒放与定格
Retiming, reverse and freeze
显式速度/曲线/Bezier/定格点 → 视频时钟与音频映射。
Explicit speed/curves/Bezier/freeze points → video clocks and audio mapping.
timeline edit; render
变速音频后端各有边界；可选 Rubber Band R3 需要已有原生工具。
Audio-retime backends differ; optional Rubber Band R3 requires existing native tools.
关键帧与缓动
Keyframes and easing
位置、锚点、缩放、旋转、透明度、裁切、蒙版、音量/声像 → 逐帧动画。
Position, anchor, scale, rotation, opacity, crop, masks, volume and pan → frame-evaluated animation.
timeline compose; schema show
hold/linear/ease_in/ease_out/ease_in_out/bezier；枚举/布尔值不推断为连续动画。
hold/linear/ease_in/ease_out/ease_in_out/bezier; enum/boolean channels are not assumed continuous.
12 套运镜预设
12 camera/motion presets
推拉、上下左右平移、Ken Burns、旋入/旋出、淡入/淡出、shake → 可编辑关键帧。
Push/pull, four pan directions, Ken Burns, rotation, fades and shake → editable keyframes.
motion list/inspect/apply
参数有界；是明确关键帧预设，不是 AI 三维相机或全部商业运镜库。
Bounded keyframe presets, not AI 3D cameras or an entire commercial motion library.
转场与剪口效果
Transitions and cut effects
相邻片段与源句柄 → 淡化、擦除、滑动、黑/白场、圆形等已声明转场。
Adjacent clips and handles → declared fades, wipes, slides, black/white fades, circular and other transitions.
timeline transition; capabilities
以默认渲染路径和具体层级为准；Float32 后续转场候选未随本版提供。
Support depends on renderer and layer context; later Float32 transition candidates are not bundled.
几何蒙版与逐帧修正
Geometric masks and frame corrections
矩形/圆/椭圆/路径/多边形 → 反选、羽化、动画、编码蒙版与修正。
Rectangles/circles/ellipses/paths/polygons → inversion, feathering, animation, encoded masks and corrections.
timeline compose; media mask-edit; quality mask
路径点数和采样受限；几何通过不等于语义分割/身份正确。
Point topology and sampling are bounded; geometric checks do not prove semantic identity.
图层合成与混合
Layer compositing and blending
多轨视觉层 → normal/multiply/screen/overlay/difference/addition/softlight/hardlight。
Visual layers → normal/multiply/screen/overlay/difference/addition/softlight/hardlight.
timeline compose; capabilities
默认路径主要为编码 8-bit RGB；不宣称线性光/HDR 合成等价。
The default path mainly uses encoded 8-bit RGB, without general linear-light/HDR equivalence.
46 个效果处理算子
46 processing operators
模糊/锐化、降噪、色调、曲线、HSL、色键、暗角、颗粒等 → 可配置效果链。
Blur/sharpen, denoise, tone, curves, HSL, keying, vignette, noise and more → configurable chains.
effects list/inspect
可动画参数与实际后端逐项查询；46 算子与 500 成品 LUT 是不同统计。
Inspect animated parameters and backends individually; 46 operators and 500 LUT looks are separate inventories.
500 套离线风格
500 offline looks
名称/ID/类别/许可检索 → 详情、图片预览、片段或全局应用与来源副本。
Name/ID/category/license search → details, still previews, clip/global application and provenance copies.
look list/inspect/preview/apply
500 个不同数值变换含同系列曲线；SDR 创意映射，不是 500 个独立家族。
500 distinct transforms include related curve variants; creative SDR mapping, not 500 unrelated families.
自定义 LUT 与色彩自动化
Custom LUTs and color automation
本地 .cube/.3dl/.csp/.dat → 登记、检查；支持的 3D LUT 强度与色彩参数按契约动画。
Local .cube/.3dl/.csp/.dat → registration/inspection; supported 3D LUT strength and color channels follow automation contracts.
lut register/list/inspect; effects inspect
格式登记不等于所有路径都完整解析；完整 CUBE 才有对应强度/浮点支持。
Registration does not imply complete parsing on every path; full CUBE data is required for the corresponding intensity/float features.
显式 Float32 像素路径
Explicit Float32 pixel pipeline
声明输入/工作/输出信号、顺序与预算 → 原生浮点色彩、LUT/shaper、选定空间处理和 surface。
Declared source/working/output signals, ordering and budgets → float color, LUT/shaper, selected spatial processing and surfaces.
render; preview; surface export/inspect
必须显式选择 float32-native-v1；能力子集，拒绝不支持项，非完整 HDR/ICC 管线。
Explicit float32-native-v1 selection; a bounded subset that refuses unsupported features, not a complete HDR/ICC pipeline.
字幕、文字与分段
Subtitles, text and segmentation
SRT/VTT/ASS/SSA/TTML 或文字 → 规范化、分段、双语、文字层、逐字高亮和文字动画。
SRT/VTT/ASS/SSA/TTML or text → normalization, segmentation, bilingual text, layers, word highlighting and text animation.
subtitle validate/normalize/segment; timeline compose
字体需本地可用；复杂排版、双向 shaping 与部分动画/时钟有明确近似或拒绝。
Fonts must exist locally; complex layout, bidi shaping and some clock/animation combinations have explicit approximations or refusals.
离线转写与字词对齐
Offline transcription and alignment
音频 + 已有 Whisper/CTC 模型/校正文 → 转写、字幕、字词时码与 CER 评估。
Audio + existing Whisper/CTC weights/corrected text → transcripts, captions, word/character timings and CER evaluation.
asr adapter; subtitle transcribe/align/evaluate
基础包不带权重；转写段时间不等于精确逐字对齐，既有 CTC 自然精度门槛未通过。
Weights are not bundled; segment timestamps are not precise word alignment, and the dated CTC quality gate failed.
多轨音频与总线
Multitrack audio and buses
显式音轨 → 混音、总线、音量/声像、静音/solo、淡化、EQ、压缩、降噪、响度与闪避。
Explicit audio tracks → mixing/buses, volume/pan, mute/solo, fades, EQ, compression, denoise, loudness and ducking.
audio extract; timeline compose; quality check
视频资产有声音不代表时间线自动出声；自动 PCM/LUFS 检查不代替听审。
A video containing sound does not automatically author an audio track; PCM/LUFS checks do not replace listening.
本地语音合成
Local speech synthesis
已有本地 flite 或登记 SoulX 权重/授权参考声 → WAV 资产与可选音轨。
Existing flite or registered SoulX weights/authorized voice references → WAV assets and optional audio tracks.
tts adapter/voice; tts synthesize
flite 取决于 FFmpeg 构建且限 ASCII 英文；SoulX 需 CUDA/原生依赖，非基础包自带配音库。
flite depends on the FFmpeg build and is ASCII-English only; SoulX needs CUDA/native dependencies, not bundled voices.
声道近似与模型分离
Channel approximation and model separation
音频 → center/side 近似，或已有 HDemucs 适配器的人声/伴奏 stem。
Audio → center/side approximations, or vocal/accompaniment stems via an existing HDemucs adapter.
audio separate; audio adapter
mid/side 不是 AI 人声分离；真正模型分离需权重、环境与许可。
Mid/side is not AI vocal separation; model separation needs weights, runtime and rights.
跟踪、绑定与重构图
Tracking, binding and reframing
模板/模型/已编码蒙版轨迹 → 文字/贴纸锚定、裁切与主体重构图关键帧。
Template/model/encoded-mask tracks → anchored text/stickers, crop and subject-reframe keyframes.
media track/track-bind/reframe
多目标须明确对象；置信度/蒙版不等于身份保证，支持的变换与时钟需检查。
Choose the object explicitly; confidence/masks do not guarantee identity, and supported transforms/clocks must be checked.
OCR 锚点与人脸修饰
OCR anchors and face retouch
已有 PP-OCR/OpenSeeFace 模型 → OCR 框/文字、锚点运镜、人脸点位与受限修饰。
Existing PP-OCR/OpenSeeFace models → text polygons, anchor camera keys, landmarks and bounded retouch.
ocr adapter/scan/anchors; face adapter/scan/retouch
已有 ONNX CPU 环境与权重；不是完整 UI 行为识别、美妆、瘦身或脸部生成。
Existing ONNX CPU runtime and weights; not full UI action detection, makeup, body sculpting or face generation.
人像抠像与对象分割
Human matting and object segmentation
已有 RVM/SAM2 + 提示点/框 → 透明视频、对象 mask 和可编辑派生资产。
Existing RVM/SAM2 + points/boxes → alpha video, object masks and editable derived assets.
media adapter; media matting
RVM 人像与 SAM2 对象分割不同；概率 mask 不是物理发丝 matte，需检查运动/遮挡。
RVM human matting and SAM2 segmentation differ; probability masks are not physical hair mattes and require motion/occlusion review.
修复、生成编辑与扩画
Inpainting, generative edits and outpainting
已有 LaMa/VACE + 蒙版/提示 → 修复或扩大画布，保留来源与可重放 recipe。
Existing LaMa/VACE + masks/prompts → repairs or expanded canvases with provenance and replayable recipes.
media inpaint/outpaint; media adapter
LaMa 逐帧不保证时序；VACE 需 CUDA 且仅窗口联合；自然纹理/时序质量未普遍验收。
Framewise LaMa has no temporal guarantee; VACE needs CUDA and joint windows only; broad natural texture/temporal quality remains unaccepted.
HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas 动效
HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas motion
受信任本地源码/素材/字体 → 可编辑模板控件、透明标题、逐笔描线、布局诊断与时间线合成。
Trusted local source/assets/fonts → editable controls, alpha titles, stroke motion, layout diagnostics and timeline compositing.
motion html-*; motion stroke-source
另需已有 Node/Playwright/Chromium；非任意网页沙箱，不自动下载浏览器。
Requires existing Node/Playwright/Chromium; not an arbitrary-page sandbox and does not download a browser.
参数模板与批量变体
Parameterized templates and variants
本地 JSON 模板 + 类型变量 → 可编辑项目变体、批量输入与模板快照。
Local JSON templates + typed variables → editable variants, batch inputs and template snapshots.
template apply/batch
支持 asset/color/enum 等类型；复杂条件图和表达式执行未实现。
Includes asset/color/enum types; complex conditional graphs and expression evaluation are pending.
素材索引与片段组复用
Asset indexing and reusable fragments
素材目录/已编辑片段 → 检索、重复/相似检查、跨项目片段组与依赖闭包。
Asset folders/edited clips → search, duplicates/similarity, cross-project fragments and dependency closure.
library index/search/duplicates/similar; fragment
用户自建资源库，未内置商业素材订阅/正版音乐库存。
User-owned libraries; no bundled commercial stock subscription or licensed-music catalog.
帧、区间与缓存预览
Frame/range preview and caching
工程 + 明确帧/区间 → PNG/短视频/缓存与可验证采样证据。
Projects + explicit frames/ranges → PNG/short video/cache and verifiable sample evidence.
preview frame/range; cache; preview cache-*
预览不是完整成片核验；色彩路径与缓存签名需一致。
Preview does not validate the entire delivery; renderer/color path and cache signatures must match.
输出、编码与硬件探测
Delivery, encoding and hardware probes
工程 → MP4/WebM/MKV、编码/像素/音频配置、透明输出与 manifest。
Projects → MP4/WebM/MKV, codec/pixel/audio configuration, alpha output and manifests.
render
编码器取决于本地 FFmpeg；硬件实际探测，CPU 效果未整体 GPU 化，无实时/4K 性能保证。
Codecs depend on local FFmpeg; hardware is probed, CPU effects are not globally GPU-ported, and real-time/4K performance is not guaranteed.
持久队列、重试与取消
Persistent queues, retry and cancel
冻结项目快照 → 本地排队、有限 worker、显式重试/取消与串行元数据提交。
Frozen snapshots → local jobs, bounded workers, explicit retry/cancel and serialized metadata commits.
queue enqueue/list/inspect/run/cancel
默认串行；并发需满足门禁，不是分布式云渲染服务。
Sequential by default; concurrency has gates and is not distributed cloud rendering.
成片、Scope 与 golden 核验
Output, scopes and golden checks
实际编码文件 → 音画/帧率/画幅/时长、响度/黑场、色彩 Scope、蒙版和 golden 差异报告。
Actual encoded files → stream/fps/canvas/duration, loudness/black frames, scopes, masks and golden differences.
quality check/scopes/mask/golden
自动检查、静态目检、连续播放、人工听审分别记录；不等于商业成片质量认证。
Automatic checks, static review, playback and listening are recorded separately, without general creative-quality certification.
权利台账与本地策略
Rights ledger and local policy
素材/字体/LUT/模型/模板证据 → 依赖台账、变更历史、影响/撤回与发布门禁。
Media/font/LUT/model/template evidence → dependency ledger, history, impact/retraction and publish gates.
rights; policy audit; render --publish
--publish 只检查本地权利，不上传；台账不自动裁定版权。
--publish checks local rights without uploading; the ledger does not adjudicate copyright.
项目与时间线交换
Project and timeline interchange
Agent JSON/package、OTIO、Kdenlive MLT、已有合法明文草稿 → 导入/导出与损失报告。
Agent JSON/package, OTIO, Kdenlive MLT and lawful local plaintext drafts → import/export and loss reports.
convert import/export
Exact/Approximate/Unsupported/Failed 逐项报告；明文草稿不调用剪映，不解密或下载专有资源。
Per-feature Exact/Approximate/Unsupported/Failed reports; plaintext drafts neither run Jianying nor decrypt/fetch proprietary resources.
管道诊断与错误交付
Pipeline diagnostics and failure artifacts
失败操作 → 有界日志、diagnostic manifest、显式导出和可复查错误信息。
Failed operations → bounded logs, diagnostic manifests, explicit exports and inspectable errors.
diagnostics list/show/export; operation inspect
失败/拒绝不是成功渲染；包含本地路径的诊断需按交付范围处理。
A failure/refusal is not a successful render; review local-path information before sharing diagnostics.
创意、内容与投放分析
Creative, content and campaign guidance
用户提供的产品、受众、参考片或投放表 → 脚本、结构、变体建议与分析。
Supplied products, audiences, references or campaign tables → scripts, structure, variant suggestions and analysis.
ad plan/apply; advisory Skills
策略 Skill 不提供广告平台连接、自动投放、实时数据或效果保证。
Advisory Skills do not supply ad-platform connectors, automatic buying, live data or performance guarantees.
services: 本地 Agent 工具服务
Python 3.13 + 已安装包；Agent 可通过命令行或 Skill 调用。
Python 3.13 + installed package; callable by an Agent shell or Skill.
不内置 SaaS、HTTP API 或 MCP server；可由调用方自行封装。
No built-in SaaS, HTTP API or MCP server; callers may wrap the CLI.
Agent Project、快照、锁、操作与恢复记录。
Agent Projects, snapshots, locks, operations and recovery records.
不是多人云协作数据库。
Not a multiuser cloud collaboration database.
已有 FFmpeg/ffprobe，素材均来自本地。
实际编码器/滤镜可用性取决于当前 FFmpeg。
Codec/filter availability depends on the installed FFmpeg build.
NumPy 与声明的 signal/预算；与默认管线分开检查。
NumPy and declared signals/budgets; checked separately from the default pipeline.
子集实现，非通用 FFmpeg 或剪映内核的完整替代。
A supported subset, not a complete replacement for every FFmpeg/Jianying operation.
基础解析 + 可选模型
字幕文件解析可直接用；Whisper/CTC/SoulX 需已有注册环境。
Subtitle parsing is direct; Whisper/CTC/SoulX need registered existing runtimes.
无默认云转写/配音供应商。
No default cloud transcription or voice provider.
RVM/SAM2/LaMa/VACE/跟踪/OCR/人脸的各自原生依赖与权重。
Per-adapter native dependencies and weights for RVM/SAM2/LaMa/VACE/tracking/OCR/faces.
基础包无模型权重，未配置不能声明已执行。
No bundled model weights; an unconfigured adapter is not an executed capability.
明确登记已有 Node、Playwright、Chromium、模板、图片和字体。
Explicitly registered existing Node, Playwright, Chromium, templates, images and fonts.
不依赖 OpenFilm 在线服务；不自动安装浏览器。
No OpenFilm online service dependency or automatic browser installation.
500 LUT 随包；素材、字体、音乐、模板由用户登记或自建。
500 bundled LUTs; media, fonts, music and templates are registered/provided by users.
不存在完整商业素材/模板订阅库。
